title: Canonical weak convergence in a half-plane
statement:
Let $C$ be an abelian category, $X$ a type-zero bigraded exact couple
[def-sp-exact-couple], and $a\in\mathbb Z$. Assume $D^{p,q}=0$ for $q<a$,
and $E^{p,q}=0$ for $p<0$ or $q<a$. Let $L$ be limiting cycles and boundaries
and $A^n$ alpha diagonal colimits [def-sp-convergence]. Suppose $A^n=D^{0,n}$
and the zeroth cocone maps are the identity after transport. Then the maps
$D^{p,q}\to E_\infty^{p,q}$ and $D^{p,q}\to\operatorname{gr}^p A^{p+q}$ of
[def-sp-convergence], with image filtration [def-sp-filtration], are epimorphisms
with the same kernel at every bidegree. Equivalently, $X$ weakly converges to $(L,A)$.

source.place: proof paragraph 2: stabilized derived-couple quotient and equality of the canonical kernels

proof.text: The canonical map to the graded piece is epi without support assumptions: it is an equality transport, the image epimorphism, and a cokernel projection. If q<a, D(p,q) is zero, so the graded target is zero; E(p,q) is zero too, hence the infinite target is zero. If p<0, exactness makes nonpositive diagonal alpha maps invertible, and normalization of the cocone at zero makes both iota_p and iota_(p+1) invertible. Both filtration steps are top, so the graded target is zero; the infinite target is zero since E(p,q) is zero. In either case both maps are epi and both kernels are top.

For the remaining bidegrees choose r=(max(p,q-a)+1).toNat, giving p<=r and q-a<r. Every derived E entry outside the original support is zero by induction using the kernel inclusion and derived cokernel projection. For t>=r the outgoing differential has target q-1-t<a and the incoming differential has source p-t-2<0, so both vanish. Rewrite the cycle and boundary recurrences to prove stationarity; the incoming-boundary pullback of bottom is the kernel of the projection. Induction gives equality with the rth values throughout the tail. Monotonicity and the GLB/LUB properties identify L.Z and L.B with these stationary values. The zero-page induction is stated pointwise for any initially zero bidegree, without half-plane assumptions. Stationarity is proved for any CycleBoundaryTower X, not just the constructed tower. For the boundary recurrence, use the general pullback identity pullback(f)(ker g)=ker(f composed with g), specialized to g=id; the identity kernel is bottom by its zero composite equation. The general kernel pullback helper needs only a category with zero morphisms, kernels and pullbacks, not an abelian category.

Use pageCouple_image: the monic inclusion of D_r(p+2,q-1) into the original D has the same image as the rfold incoming alpha map, whose source is D(p+2+r,q-1-r)=0 by hD. Its image is bottom, so the inclusion is zero; being mono, its source D_r(p+2,q-1) is zero. The limiting-cycle factorization of initialG factors through the larger finite cycle object. Apply lem-sp-finite-page-image-quotient to obtain the finite-page/image-graded isomorphism and its canonical projection equation.

The tower projection is epi with kernel the inclusion of the finite boundary in the finite cycle. Construct its isomorphism from the cokernel of that inclusion: the forward map is cokernel.desc, the inverse is Abelian.epiDesc; cancellation of the two epis proves the inverse identities. Transport along the proved equalities L.Z=Z_r and L.B=B_r. Cancellation of the monic finite cycle arrow identifies the limiting-cycle lift followed by its inclusion with the finite lift of initialG. Compose this cokernel isomorphism with the finite-page/graded isomorphism to obtain toPageInfinity followed by its hom equal to toGradedPiece. The latter is epi, so the former is epi by composing with the inverse isomorphism. Postcomposition with a mono preserves kernelSubobject, proving equality of kernels.

lean.statement: theorem halfPlane_weak_convergence (X : BigradedExactCouple C 0) (a : ℤ) (hD : ∀ p q : ℤ, q < a → IsZero (X.D p q)) (hE : ∀ p q : ℤ, (p < 0 ∨ q < a) → IsZero (X.E p q)) (L : LimitSubobjects X) (A : ∀ n : ℤ, AlphaColimit X n) (hA : ∀ n : ℤ, (A n).obj = X.D 0 n) (hι : ∀ n : ℤ, (A n).ι 0 ≫ eqToHom (hA n) = eqToHom (by congr 1; omega)) : X.WeaklyConvergesTo L A
